blocks.tamil_translation: (by reciting these three Kalimahs ten times each after the five daily Salahs) it comes to 150 times. But on the scale of deeds it becomes 1500 (being multiplied tenfold). Another thing: when you go to bed, recite Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah and Allahu Akbar 100 times (recite Subhanallah 33 times, Alhamdulillah 33 times and Allahu Akbar 34 times). In saying this, a hundred Kalimahs are said, and their reward comes to 1000 (together with this and what was recited after the Salahs throughout the day, the total comes to 2500 rewards). The Prophet ﷺ said, “Who could there be who commits 2500 sins in one day?' That is, so many sins cannot occur, and 2500 rewards are written. When Hazrat Abdullah (RA) asked, “O Messenger of Allah! What is the reason that the number of those who act upon this is small?” the Prophet ﷺ explained, “So that the thought of reciting these Kalimahs does not come, Shaytan reminds him in his Salah of such-and-such a need, of such-and-such matters. In the end he drowns him in those very thoughts and engages him in other work. Moreover, he comes to him in his bed and puts him to sleep, and in the end he falls asleep without being able to recite these Kalimahs.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ أَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ وَقَالَ: يَا مُعَاذُ وَاللهِ إِنِّي لأُحِبُّكَ فَقَالَ: أُوصِيكَ يَا مُعَاذُ! لَا تَدَعَنَّ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ تَقُولُ: اَللّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَي ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في الاستغفار رقم:١٥٢٢
blocks.tamil_translation: The Prophet ﷺ took hold of the hands of Hazrat Mu'adh (RA) and said, “O Mu'adh, by Allah! I love you”. And, after every Salah you (اَللّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَي ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ)
